exercises.title: Everyday phrases (Lead-in)
exercises.instruction: Complete the phrases from the Lead-in pictures with ONE verb. Change the form of the verb if necessary.

items.prompt: Every morning I ____ breakfast at 7am.
items.explanation: have breakfast — ăn sáng (không dùng "eat a breakfast").

items.prompt: I usually ____ the bus to college at 7:30.
After dinner, my sister ____ online and chats to her friends.
items.explanation: go online — chủ ngữ số ít (my sister) → goes.

items.prompt: My dad ____ TV in the living room every evening.
I always ____ to bed at about 10:30pm.
At the weekend, I ____ with friends in a café.
items.explanation: relax with friends — thư giãn cùng bạn.

exercises.title: Ping in England – choose the correct word (Ex. 3)
exercises.instruction: Read the sentences about Ping, a young man on a language course in England. Choose the best answer, A, B or C.

items.prompt: Ping ____ at 7:30am every morning and has breakfast with his host family.
items.explanation: get up = thức dậy, rời giường buổi sáng. stand up = đứng lên (từ tư thế ngồi); stay up = thức khuya.

items.prompt: At 8:30am, he ____ the bus to his language school.
items.explanation: Cụm cố định: catch the bus (bắt xe buýt). "go" và "travel" cần giới từ: go/travel by bus.

items.prompt: During the day, Ping studies English and ____ to his classmates.
items.explanation: chat to somebody = trò chuyện với ai. "laugh to" sai; "tell" cần tân ngữ trực tiếp (tell them a story).

items.prompt: Everyone speaks English in his class because the students all ____ from different countries around the world.
items.explanation: come from = đến từ (quê ở đâu). arrive from = vừa tới từ (một chuyến đi), không hợp nghĩa "quê quán".

items.prompt: After Ping finishes school at 3:00pm, he often ____ some sightseeing in the city with his friends.
items.explanation: Cụm cố định: do some sightseeing (đi tham quan).

items.prompt: In the evening, Ping relaxes with his host family, ____ TV or goes online.
items.explanation: watch TV = xem TV (theo dõi một thứ đang chuyển động). see = nhìn thấy; look (at) = nhìn vào.

exercises.title: Words in "A Day in the Life"
exercises.instruction: Read the sentences from the text again and choose the best meaning of the phrase in bold. Use the context to help you.

stimulus.text:
NINA — NORWAY

I live in a village on Norway's Atlantic coast. I get up at 7:30am and walk to college. Classes begin at 8:30am and finish at 3pm. After that, I go to one of the college clubs. These are not very expensive and there are lots to choose from. I do athletics and football but you can also do things like folk dancing and cross-country skiing. When my parents come home from work, my dad makes dinner and we all eat together. After that, my mum takes me out for a driving lesson. I've got my test soon and I need to practise!

AVA — AUSTRALIA

I'm from a small town in Queensland. Most people in Australia live near the coast, but we live on a cattle farm in the centre of the country. I get up at around 7am and have breakfast. My mum teaches at my college, so I usually go with her in the car instead of taking the bus. College starts at 8:30am and finishes at 4pm. When I get home, I help my dad on the farm for a few hours. In the evenings, I try to watch TV but I'm usually too tired. I go to bed at about 10:00pm.

MICHAEL — BRAZIL

I live in Rio de Janeiro. I get up at 6am and catch a bus to college at 6:30am. Lessons start at 7:20am. We have a break at 9:50am and then study until 12:30pm. I get home at about 1:40pm. After that, I often go to the beach with my friends to swim in the ocean or play beach volleyball, but I sometimes also just stay at home to sleep or study. In the evenings, I cook dinner for my family, then we watch TV or listen to the radio before bed. I switch off my light at about 10pm.
stimulus.caption: A Day in the Life (tr. 12)

items.prompt: "You can also do things like **folk dancing** and cross-country skiing." — What is folk dancing?

options.text: a kind of traditional activity / dance

items.explanation: "things like…" giới thiệu các hoạt động ở câu lạc bộ → folk dancing = múa dân gian.

items.prompt: "We live on a **cattle farm** in the centre of the country." — What are cattle?
items.explanation: Cattle = gia súc (bò). Ava còn "help my dad on the farm" — đúng ngữ cảnh trang trại.

items.prompt: "My mum teaches at my college, so I usually go with her in the car **instead of** taking the bus."
items.explanation: Ava đi ô tô với mẹ, KHÔNG đi xe buýt → instead of = thay vì.

items.prompt: "In the evenings, I try to watch TV but I'm usually **too tired**."

options.text: so tired that I can't do it

items.explanation: "try to… but…" → muốn xem TV nhưng không làm được vì quá mệt (làm trang trại cả buổi chiều).

items.prompt: "I **switch off** my light at about 10pm."

options.text: turn the light off (go to sleep)

items.explanation: switch off = tắt; tắt đèn lúc 10pm = giờ đi ngủ.

exercises.title: Dan's daily routine (Ex. 10)
exercises.instruction: Read the information about Dan, a student at a university in the UK. Put the verbs in brackets into the present simple.

stimulus.caption: TIP 11
rows: usually, always, sometimes, often, never — they tell you how often Dan does something.

items.prompt: Dan usually ____ (get up) at 8am, ____ (have) a shower and ____ (eat) breakfast.
items.explanation: Chủ ngữ Dan (he) → gets up, has (bất quy tắc: have → has), eats.

items.prompt: After that, he always ____ (get) his books ready and then ____ (go) to his lectures until midday.
items.explanation: go → goes (động từ tận cùng -o thêm -es).

items.prompt: He usually ____ (return) home and ____ (make) lunch for himself at about 12:30pm.
Then, he sometimes ____ (watch) a bit of TV. At about 3pm, he often ____ (meet) a friend for coffee.
At 3:30pm, they sometimes ____ (go) to the library together.
items.explanation: Chủ ngữ "they" (số nhiều) → giữ nguyên go.

items.prompt: Dan always ____ (study) for a few hours and then at around 6:30pm he ____ (go) home.
He usually ____ (cook) dinner for himself and his flatmates. In the evening, he sometimes ____ (exercise) at the gym.
After that, he relaxes in front of the TV or ____ (see) his friends. He never goes to bed early, but usually ____ (fall) asleep at around midnight.

exercises.title: Phrases with a similar meaning – housework (Ex. 12)
exercises.instruction: Read the text about housework and match each phrase (1–6) with a phrase with a similar meaning (A–F).

stimulus.text: I often help a lot around the house and I usually help my mum **do the laundry**. My brother is lazy and he never washes his clothes. He always leaves them in a pile on his bedroom floor. In the evening after school, I always **tidy up** my room. I put things away and get my schoolbag ready for the next day. My dad sometimes **washes up** after dinner. We don't have a dishwasher at the moment because our old one broke down, so he has to clean the dishes by himself. My sister likes cooking, so she often helps mum **make lunch and dinner**. She prepared a delicious meal of roast chicken at the weekend. Sometimes my brother **puts the rubbish out**, but he usually just leaves it by the back door instead of taking it out to the bins. We all usually try and help and **do the cleaning**. When the housework is done, we always relax and watch TV.
stimulus.caption: Ex. 12 — Helping around the house

items.explanation: do the laundry = giặt quần áo. Bài: "My brother… never washes his clothes."
tidy up = dọn gọn; câu sau giải thích "I put things away".
wash up = rửa bát; "he has to clean the dishes by himself".
make dinner = prepare a meal; "She prepared a delicious meal".
put the rubbish out = mang rác ra thùng; "taking it out to the bins".
do the cleaning ≈ do the housework; "When the housework is done…".

exercises.title: Grammar box: questions and answers (Ex. 7)
exercises.instruction: Read the Grammar box, then match questions 1–3 with answers A–C.

items.left: What do we use the present simple for?
items.right: to talk about every day routines and habits
items.explanation: Hiện tại đơn diễn tả thói quen, hoạt động lặp lại.

items.left: Why do we use adverbs of frequency?
items.right: to say how often we do something
items.explanation: always/usually/often/sometimes/never cho biết mức độ thường xuyên.

items.left: What do verbs for he/she/it end in?

exercises.title: Third person verb endings (Ex. 8)
exercises.instruction: Put each verb into the correct group for he/she/it.

items.explanation: plays — nguyên âm + y chỉ thêm -s
stays — nguyên âm + y chỉ thêm -s

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct form of the verb in each sentence.

exercises.title: Position of frequency adverbs
exercises.instruction: Put the words in the correct order to make sentences. Frequency adverbs go BEFORE most verbs and AFTER the verb "be".

items.explanation: always đứng trước động từ thường gets up.

exercises.title: Sequencing words and frequency adverbs
exercises.instruction: Complete the sentences with after that, next, then, finally, always or never.

items.prompt: First, I get up at 6:30am. ____, I have a shower.
items.explanation: Từ trình tự nối hai hoạt động liên tiếp.

items.prompt: I go to bed at 10pm because I ____ get up early. I am never late for class.
My brother is lazy. He ____ washes his clothes.
I study in the library all afternoon. ____, at 10pm, I go to bed.
items.explanation: Finally = cuối cùng (hoạt động cuối ngày).

exercises.title: Sentences describing a routine
exercises.instruction: Put the words in the correct order to make sentences. Remember the comma after a sequencing word.

items.explanation: Thời gian đứng đầu câu + dấu phẩy.

exercises.title: Write about your daily routine (Ex. 11)
exercises.instruction: Look again at the paragraph about Dan (Ex. 10). Write a paragraph (70–100 words) about YOUR daily routine: what you do and when. Use at least four frequency adverbs (always, usually, often, sometimes, never) and two sequencing words (After that, Then, Next…). Example: I sometimes do the laundry. I never make dinner. My brother often takes out the bins.

checklist: Nêu thời gian cho các hoạt động (at 7am, in the evening…)
Dùng ≥4 trạng từ tần suất, đặt đúng vị trí
Có từ chỉ trình tự nối câu
rubric.sampleAnswer: I usually get up at 6:30am and have breakfast with my family. After that, I always catch the bus to school at 7am. Lessons start at 7:30am and finish at 4:30pm. I often chat to my friends during the break. When I get home, I sometimes help my mum make dinner, but I never wash up because my brother does it. Then, I usually do my homework for two hours. In the evening, I often go online or watch TV. I go to bed at about 11pm.
commonErrors: Đặt trạng từ tần suất sau động từ thường (I go always)
Viết "at the morning" thay vì "in the morning"

exercises.title: A day in the life of Julia Grant (Ex. 13)
exercises.instruction: Look at the pictures of Julia Grant, a volunteer on a science project. Write a paragraph (80–120 words) describing a day in Julia's life. (1) Begin: "Julia Grant is 21 years old and works as a volunteer on a science project in Fiji. Every morning, she …" (2) Write what she does and when. (3) Use After that… / Next… / Then… (4) Use frequency adverbs.

stimulus.caption: A day in the life of Julia Grant in Fiji

checklist: Bắt đầu đúng câu mở đầu đề cho
Mô tả ít nhất 6 hoạt động trong tranh theo thứ tự
Có giờ cụ thể cho các hoạt động
rubric.sampleAnswer: Julia Grant is 21 years old and works as a volunteer on a science project in Fiji. Every morning, she gets up at 6:30am. After that, she always checks her emails on her laptop. Next, she cooks breakfast with her friend at about 8am. Then, she works outside and washes the equipment for the project. At lunchtime, she usually hangs out the washing. In the afternoon, she sometimes reads a book on the beach. Some days, she goes snorkelling and looks at the turtles. In the evening, she often has dinner in a small restaurant by the sea. Finally, she sits by the campfire with her friends before she goes to bed.
commonErrors: she go / she have → she goes / she has
Quên dấu phẩy sau After that, Next, Then

exercises.title: Before you listen: true or false? (Ex. 15)
exercises.instruction: Read the information on the website about a student exchange programme. Are the sentences true or false?

stimulus.caption: Spend a term or a whole year in another country
stimulus.text:
Stay with a host family and go to a local college. Learn all about the culture, and maybe learn a new language. Make new friends and have a great time. You need to pay for flights and take some pocket money, but that's all. Host families are not paid. All they ask is that you help with jobs around the house and join in with family activities.

Go to student_exchange.com and explore our website to learn more!

items.prompt: All students spend at least a year abroad.
items.explanation: Trang web: "Spend a **term or** a whole year" → có thể chỉ 1 học kỳ (ít hơn 1 năm) — MINI TIP 15.1.

items.prompt: Host families give students pocket money during their stay.
items.explanation: "You need to pay for flights and **take some pocket money**" → học sinh tự mang tiền, gia đình không cho — MINI TIP 15.2.

items.prompt: Students should do housework and be involved with family activities.
items.explanation: "help with jobs around the house and **join in with** family activities" — join in with = tham gia (MINI TIP 15.3).

exercises.title: Words with a similar meaning
exercises.instruction: The speakers use different words from the list A–H. Choose the activity that has the same meaning as what the speaker says.

"She's really good at **painting and drawing**."
"She spends a lot of time outdoors, **planting flowers and cutting the grass**."
items.explanation: trồng hoa, cắt cỏ = chăm sóc vườn.

items.prompt: "I love playing **volleyball and basketball**."
items.explanation: bóng chuyền, bóng rổ = thể thao đồng đội.

exercises.title: Tips for a 1–2 minute talk
exercises.instruction: Choose the CORRECT way to prepare and speak.

items.prompt: In the one minute of preparation time, you should…

options.text: write full sentences and read them out
write key words and short phrases for each point

items.explanation: Sách nhấn mạnh: chỉ ghi từ/cụm ngắn; đọc câu viết sẵn sẽ mất điểm.

items.prompt: If you can't remember who you go to school with, you should…

options.text: invent a reasonable detail and keep talking

items.explanation: 3 ý đầu là thông tin thực tế — bạn có thể bịa nếu cần (TIP 19).

items.prompt: Which answer is longer and better?

options.text: I like the evening because I can relax and chat to my friends, for example on Messenger.

items.explanation: Thêm lý do (because) và ví dụ (for example) — bullet box của sách.

items.prompt: According to Ex. 20, which is a BAD sign?

options.text: The talk is easy to understand.
The speaker often pauses and hesitates.
The speaker stays on the topic.

items.explanation: Ngập ngừng, dừng lại nhiều làm giảm độ trôi chảy (fluency).

exercises.title: Speaking: questions about your routine (Ex. 4, 18)
exercises.instruction: Answer each question in 15–25 seconds: a direct answer → a reason → an example.

items.prompt: What time does your school, college or job start and finish?
items.sampleAnswer: My school starts at seven thirty in the morning and finishes at about four thirty. It's quite a long day, so I'm usually tired when I get home, but I like the afternoon lessons because we often do group work.
items.sampleNote: Trả lời thẳng giờ giấc, thêm cảm nhận + lý do.

items.prompt: What do young people like to do in the evenings in your country?
items.sampleAnswer: Most young people in Vietnam like to go online in the evenings. For example, they chat with friends or watch videos on their phones. Some people also go out for milk tea or play football with their friends.
items.sampleNote: Nêu ý chính + ví dụ cụ thể (for example).

items.prompt: Would you like to go to another country to study? Why or why not?
items.sampleAnswer: Yes, I would. I'd love to study in Australia because I want to improve my English and learn about a new culture. I think living with a host family would be a great experience.
items.sampleNote: Yes/No rõ ràng → lý do (because) → thêm một chi tiết.

exercises.title: Speaking: an average day (Ex. 19–21)
exercises.instruction: Read the task, spend one minute making notes, then speak for 1–2 minutes. Describe what you usually do on an average day. You should say: what you do · who you do it with · where you do it — and explain what you enjoy most about your day and why.

items.prompt:
Describe what you usually do on an average day.
You should say:
• what you do
• who you do it with
• where you do it
and explain what you enjoy most about your day and why.
items.sampleAnswer: I'd like to talk about a normal weekday for me. I usually get up at about half past six, and the first thing I do is have a quick breakfast with my mum in the kitchen. After that, I catch the bus to school with my best friend, Lan, because we live on the same street. Lessons start at seven thirty and finish at about four thirty, so I spend most of the day at school with my classmates. In the break, we often chat or play badminton in the yard. When I get home, I sometimes help my mum make dinner, and then I do my homework in my bedroom for about two hours. In the evening, I usually watch TV with my family or go online. What I enjoy most about my day is the evening, because I can finally relax. For example, last night I watched a funny film with my little brother and we laughed a lot. I normally go to bed at around eleven.
items.sampleNote: Đi theo thứ tự thời gian, mỗi ý có chi tiết (giờ, người, nơi chốn). Phần "explain" có lý do (because) và ví dụ cụ thể (last night…).
